newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ registered unemployed down 1.2 pct in January.
newsitem.headline: NZ registered unemployed down 1.2 pct in January.

text.p: Employment minister Peter McCardle said on Thursday the number of registered unemployed New Zealanders, excluding vacation workers, fell 1.2 percent to 164,147 in January.
The figure compares to 166,164 in December and 159,143 in November. The January 1996 total was 159,043.
There were 104,585 males and 59,562 females registered as unemployed in January 1997.
The number of vacation workers registered as unemployed in January fell 27.1 percent to 2,381.
McCardle said registered unemployment regularly fell in January and the reduction was generally in line with expectations.

However, he said forecasting and register comparisons would be more complex in the next few months as new work assistance measures for some spouses of unemployment beneficiaries, and other beneficiaries, would see some new groups joining the register.
